headlines.title: Synopsys’ Long-Term Earnings Targets Come In ‘Well Ahead’ Of Consensus, BofA Says — Firm Lifts Target By $100
headlines.summary: BofA raised its earnings estimates after Synopsys laid out a financial framework through 2030 that calls for faster growth and expanding margins, according to TheFly

headlines.title: Synopsys signs $1bn-plus silicon IP deal with Amazon
headlines.summary: Building on 15 years of collaboration, the agreement covers EDA tools, simulation, agentic AI and multiphysics solutions.

headlines.title: Synopsys (SNPS) vs Cadence (CDNS): Which is a Better Stock to Buy?
headlines.summary: Synopsys, Inc. (NASDAQ:SNPS) and Cadence Design Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:CDNS) between them supply almost all of the software used to design advanced chips. Both have fallen over the past twelve months even as the chips they help create have driven the market higher.

headlines.title: Why Synopsys Stock Soared Nearly 5% Higher Today
headlines.summary: It has signed new arrangements with two very prominent partners.

headlines.title: Synopsys Investor Day Lifts 2030 Growth Outlook on AI, IP and Ansys Synergies
headlines.summary: Synopsys (NASDAQ:SNPS) used its Investor Day to outline a higher long-term growth outlook, driven by demand for application-specific silicon, AI-enabled engineering workflows and the integration of Ansys simulation technology.

description: Synopsys, Inc. provides design IP solutions in the semiconductor and electronics industries. It operates in two segments, Design Automation and Design IP. The company offers Digital and Custom IC Design solution that provides digital design implementation solutions; Verification solution that offers virtual prototyping, static and formal verification, simulation, emulation, field programmable gate array (FPGA)-based prototyping, and debug solutions; FPGA design products that are programmed to perform specific functions; synopsys technology computer-aided design (TCAD), mask synthesis, and manufacturing analytic solutions; and AI-driven EDA solutions. It also provides pre-verified and silicon-proven IP solutions, logic libraries and embedded memories, processor and security solutions, IP Offerings for the automotive market, SOC infrastructure IP, data path and building block IP, and mathematical and floating-point components. Synopsys, Inc. has a strategic collaboration with Arm Holdings plc for development of AGI CPU that provides solutions across its full-stack design portfolio including EDA, interface IP, and hardware-assisted verification (HAV). The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California.
